topics.title: DNA copying and the importance of variation

concepts.learning_objective: Explain why the creation of a DNA copy along with additional cellular apparatus is a basic event in reproduction.
Explain why DNA copies are similar but not always identical to the original.
Evaluate how variation helps a species survive when its niche changes.
Distinguish binary fission in Amoeba and Leishmania from multiple fission in Plasmodium.
Explain fragmentation in Spirogyra and why complex organisms cannot reproduce cell by cell.
Describe regeneration in Hydra and Planaria and why it differs from reproduction.

topics.title: Budding, vegetative propagation and spore formation

concepts.learning_objective: Describe budding in Hydra and yeast.
Explain vegetative propagation and tissue culture and their advantages.
Describe spore formation in Rhizopus and how spores survive.

topics.title: Why the sexual mode of reproduction?

concepts.learning_objective: Explain how combining DNA from two individuals generates more variation.
Explain why germ-cells carry half the DNA and how male and female gametes differ.
Identify the reproductive parts of a flower and distinguish unisexual from bisexual flowers.
Distinguish self- and cross-pollination and describe how fertilisation occurs.
Describe how the ovule and ovary develop after fertilisation and how a seed germinates.

topics.title: Puberty and the male reproductive system

concepts.learning_objective: Describe the changes at puberty and explain why they occur when body growth slows.
State the functions of the testes, vas deferens, urethra and accessory glands.
Identify the organs of the female reproductive system and the site of fertilisation.
Explain how the placenta nourishes the embryo and removes its wastes.
Explain why menstruation occurs when the egg is not fertilised.
Identify bacterial and viral sexually transmitted diseases and how their spread can be reduced.
Distinguish barrier, hormonal, intrauterine and surgical methods of contraception.
Evaluate the importance of a healthy sex ratio and the issue of female foeticide.
